qualification: Distinct source problem; full Lean proof of exact claimed outcome; complete written paper; independent review; reproducible verified artifact. Do not count supporting lemmas as separate outcomes.

verified.title: Diagonalizability conjecture for premagic matrices
verified.outcome: Refuted by a strictly positive 3x3 integer matrix, non-diagonalizable over R and C
verified.priority: new to project; worldwide priority not established

verified.title: Norm-one conjecture for dominant eigenvectors of non-negative premagic matrices
verified.outcome: Refuted as stated: the positive all-ones 2x2 matrix has dominant eigenvector (2,2), with squared Euclidean and Frobenius norms 8.
verified.priority: Elementary normalization correction; no worldwide novelty claim

verified.title: Eigenvalues of permutation-like matrices
verified.outcome: Every eigenvalue is zero or a root of unity; zero is an eigenvalue exactly for non-permutation matrices.
verified.priority: No worldwide priority claim; fair-discrepancy is formal verification of Shivam Patel's posted counterexample.

verified.title: Fair-discrepancy propagation for fully balanced matrices
verified.outcome: Refuted for every positive tolerance by a strictly positive matrix with equal row and column squared energies.
verified.priority: No worldwide priority claim; fair-discrepancy is formal verification of Shivam Patel's posted counterexample.
